[
  // Math mode
  { "trigger": "mk", "replacement": "$$0$", "options": "tA" },
  { "trigger": "dm", "replacement": "$$\n$0\n$$", "options": "tAw" },
  { "trigger": "beg", "replacement": "\\begin{$0}\n$1\n\\end{$0}", "options": "m" },

  // Greek letters
  { "trigger": "@a", "replacement": "\\alpha", "options": "mA" },
  { "trigger": "@b", "replacement": "\\beta", "options": "mA" },
  { "trigger": "@g", "replacement": "\\gamma", "options": "mA" },
  { "trigger": "@G", "replacement": "\\Gamma", "options": "mA" },
  { "trigger": "@d", "replacement": "\\delta", "options": "mA" },
  { "trigger": "@D", "replacement": "\\Delta", "options": "mA" },
  { "trigger": "@e", "replacement": "\\epsilon", "options": "mA" },
  { "trigger": ":e", "replacement": "\\varepsilon", "options": "mA" },
  { "trigger": "@t", "replacement": "\\theta", "options": "mA" },
  { "trigger": ":t", "replacement": "\\vartheta", "options": "mA" },
  { "trigger": "@l", "replacement": "\\lambda", "options": "mA" },
  { "trigger": "@L", "replacement": "\\Lambda", "options": "mA" },
  { "trigger": "@s", "replacement": "\\sigma", "options": "mA" },
  { "trigger": "@S", "replacement": "\\Sigma", "options": "mA" },
  { "trigger": "@o", "replacement": "\\omega", "options": "mA" },
  { "trigger": "@O", "replacement": "\\Omega", "options": "mA" },

  // Text
  { "trigger": "text", "replacement": "\\text{$0}$1", "options": "m" },
  { "trigger": "\"", "replacement": "\\text{$0}$1", "options": "mA" },

  // Powers / scripts
  { "trigger": "sr", "replacement": "^{2}", "options": "m" },
  { "trigger": "cb", "replacement": "^{3}", "options": "m" },
  { "trigger": "rd", "replacement": "^{$0}$1", "options": "m" },
  { "trigger": "_", "replacement": "_{$0}$1", "options": "m" },

  // Fractions / roots
  { "trigger": "sq", "replacement": "\\sqrt{$0}$1", "options": "m" },
  { "trigger": "//", "replacement": "\\frac{$0}{$1}$2", "options": "mA" },

  // Congruence & number theory
  { "trigger": "===", "replacement": "\\equiv", "options": "mA" },
  { "trigger": "pmod", "replacement": "\\pmod{$0}$1", "options": "m" },
  { "trigger": "abs", "replacement": "\\lvert $0 \\rvert $1", "options": "m" },

  // Relations
  { "trigger": "!=", "replacement": "\\neq", "options": "mA" },
  { "trigger": ">=", "replacement": "\\geq", "options": "mA" },
  { "trigger": "<=", "replacement": "\\leq", "options": "mA" },
  { "trigger": "=>", "replacement": "\\implies", "options": "mA" },
  { "trigger": "<->", "replacement": "\\leftrightarrow", "options": "mA" },
  { "trigger": "->", "replacement": "\\to", "options": "mA" },

  // Sets
  { "trigger": "inn", "replacement": "\\in", "options": "m" },
  { "trigger": "notin", "replacement": "\\not\\in", "options": "m" },
  { "trigger": "cap", "replacement": "\\cap", "options": "m" },
  { "trigger": "cup", "replacement": "\\cup", "options": "m" },
  { "trigger": "eset", "replacement": "\\emptyset", "options": "m" },

  // Blackboard bold
  { "trigger": "RR", "replacement": "\\mathbb{R}", "options": "mA" },
  { "trigger": "ZZ", "replacement": "\\mathbb{Z}", "options": "mA" },
  { "trigger": "NN", "replacement": "\\mathbb{N}", "options": "mA" },
  { "trigger": "CC", "replacement": "\\mathbb{C}", "options": "mA" },

  // Linear algebra
  { "trigger": "det", "replacement": "\\det", "options": "m" },
  { "trigger": "trace", "replacement": "\\mathrm{Tr}", "options": "m" },

  // Environments
  {
    "trigger": "ald",
    "replacement": "$$\n\\\\\\begin{aligned}\n$0\n\\\\\\end{aligned}\n$$",
    "options": "t"
  },
  { "trigger": "cases", "replacement": "\\begin{cases}\n$0\n\\end{cases}", "options": "m" },
  { "trigger": "pmat", "replacement": "\\begin{pmatrix}\n$0\n\\end{pmatrix}", "options": "m" },
  { "trigger": "bmat", "replacement": "\\begin{bmatrix}\n$0\n\\end{bmatrix}", "options": "m" },

  // Calculus
  { "trigger": "lim", "replacement": "\\lim_{${0:n}\\to${1:\\infty}} $2", "options": "m" },
  { "trigger": "ddt", "replacement": "\\frac{d}{dt}", "options": "m" },
  { "trigger": "int", "replacement": "\\int $0\\, d${1:x}", "options": "m" },

  // Misc
  { "trigger": "oo", "replacement": "\\infty", "options": "mA" }


]
matrixShortcutsEnvNames: pmatrix, cases, align, gather, bmatrix, Bmatrix, vmatrix, Vmatrix, array, matrix
autoEnlargeBracketsTriggers: sum, int, frac, prod, bigcup, bigcap
